complexity.notes: Correctness bug: best_buy is initialized to 100, but constraints allow prices[i] up to 10^4. If all prices exceed 100 (e.g. prices = [7000, 8000]), the phantom buy price of 100 inflates the profit (returns 7900 instead of 1000). Initialize best_buy to prices[0] (length >= 1 is guaranteed) or to float('inf'). Also, iterating 'for price in prices' would be more idiomatic than indexing with range(len(prices)).
complexity.summary: Single pass tracking the minimum buy price seen so far and the maximum profit achievable by selling at each subsequent price.
